/usr/bin/cp /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/services-provider.py "$HOME/provider"
/usr/bin/chmod 700 "$HOME/provider"
"$HOME/provider" first lookup external > "$HOME/control-first.out" 2> "$HOME/control-first.err" || [[ $? == 1 ]]
"$HOME/provider" second lookup external > "$HOME/control-second.out" 2> "$HOME/control-second.err"
printf '7101:7102:Remote User:/srv/remote:/bin/sh\n' > "$HOME/control-expected.out"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/control-second.out" "$HOME/control-expected.out" && [[ ! -s $HOME/control-first.out && ! -s $HOME/control-first.err && ! -s $HOME/control-second.err ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED provider outputs' >&2; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/mv "$HOME/provider.events" "$HOME/control.events"
: > "$HOME/provider.events"
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home && -O /tmp/parity-case && -O /tmp/parity-home && -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor ]] || { echo 'not a disposable parity guest' >&2; exit 98; }
marker=$(< /etc/bashos-parity-vm); vendor=$(< /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor)
[[ $marker =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ && $vendor == QEMU ]] || { echo 'guest identity mismatch' >&2; exit 98; }
export BASHUSERDB_PASSWD=/tmp/parity-case/passwd.fixture BASHUSERDB_CONF=/tmp/parity-case/empty.conf
userdb add-provider first "$HOME/provider" first
SECONDS=0; OUT=unset; userdb lookup timeout -V OUT > "$HOME/timeout.out" 2> "$HOME/timeout.err"; rc=$?; elapsed=$SECONDS
printf '%s\n' "$elapsed" > "$HOME/elapsed.txt"
printf 'status=%s result=%s\n' "$rc" "$OUT"
[[ $elapsed -ge 4 && $elapsed -le 7 ]] && echo deadline=bounded || echo deadline=BAD
[[ $(< "$HOME/timeout.err") == *'provider first lookup timed out'* ]] && echo diagnostic=yes || echo diagnostic=BAD
"$HOME/provider" --check-timeout
